import { rankingView, rankingFooter } from '@src/response/leaderboard/view';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/leaderboard/popularity/app';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const msg = e.MessageText || '';
  const result = await App({ bid, uid: e.uid as number });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '人气排行榜', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (!result.data.canUseFifthLayerFeature) {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '人气排行榜', realmName: result.data.realmName });

    return;
  }

  const match = msg.match(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?人气排行榜(?:\s*(\d+|榜首|附近|我的))?$/);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }

  const pageRaw = match[2];
  let page = pageRaw ? Number(pageRaw) : 1;

  if (!Number.isFinite(page) || page < 1) {
    page = 1;
  }

  const list = result.data.list;
  const view = rankingView(msg, result.data.self !== null);
  const total = list.length;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / 5));

  page = Math.min(view.page, totalPages);
  const slice = view.nearby ? result.data.nearby : list.slice((page - 1) * 5, page * 5);

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(result.data.self ? `我的排名：第${result.data.self.rank}名 · 人气${result.data.self.popularity}` : '尚未收到点赞，暂无个人排名');
  md.addNewline();

  if (slice.length === 0) {
    md.addText('暂无人气排行数据');
  } else {
    for (const item of slice) {
      const icon = item.rank === 1 ? '🥇' : item.rank === 2 ? '🥈' : item.rank === 3 ? '🥉' : `【${item.rank}】`;

      md.addBlockquote(
        createQuoteMarkdown([`${icon} ${item.name}`, `ID:${item.uid} 人气：${item.popularity}`], [{ label: '查看', command: `/查看信息 ${item.uid}` }])
      );
    }
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '人气排行榜',
      content: md,
      footer: rankingFooter('/人气排行榜'),
      nav:
        !view.nearby && totalPages > 1
          ? {
              current: page,
              total: totalPages,
              count: total,
              command: '/人气排行榜 {page}'
            }
          : undefined
    })
  );
});
